item.title: Tourism in Mountain Areas: Sustainability, Communities, and Changing Environments
item.content:encoded:
This special issue in the Journal of Outdoor Recreation and Tourism addresses tourism in mountainous regions, with emphasis on sustainability, local communities, and environmental change. The collection seeks to advance understanding of how tourism operates in mountain environments and its implications for both natural and human systems.
